chapters.title: Shamanic Technomancy
chapters.text: Steward-tribes of the Loom braid spirit and craft. Pulse, totem lattices, and Echo — not furnace magic.

chapters.title: Loom-born Origin
chapters.text: They drummed Spirit Pulse into stone, raised Resonance Totems, and walked ore through Echo until metal remembered the tribe.

chapters.title: Spirit Pulse
chapters.text: Rhythmic beats stored by PulseHandlers. Drumheart for bursts; Ley Collector for ambient trickle. Song Bench drinks generators first, then Totems.

chapters.title: Totem Lattice
chapters.text: Resonance Totems within 8 of a Song Bench. Ritual Chalk seals lasting links within 16 blocks.

chapters.title: Song Bench
chapters.text: Seat one feed item, empty-hand click to sing, shift-click to remove. Status reports Pulse, totem, and attunement stalls.

chapters.title: Echo Stages
chapters.text: Live path: raw ore/cobble/iron-like → Echo Shard (Earth) → Attuned Echo (Fire) → Bound Echo (Water) → Manifested Ingot (Spirit). Shrine Echo blocks are markers only.

chapters.title: Caches
chapters.text: Ancestral Cache locally; Deep Cache via spirit link after visiting The March.

chapters.title: Seals & Rites
chapters.text: Offer seals on a Rite Pedestal for spirit boons.

chapters.title: The March
chapters.text: Otherworld dimension reached by a charged Gate Drum.
